judgments.title: Core logic test suite (registry, capabilities, source mapping, HR/CPV parsers, sensor sessions, session orchestration, persistence)
required_evidence: Gradle jvmTest passes: DeviceRegistry tracks multiple concurrently connected devices and derives capabilities from GATT inventories (trainer fixture -> trainer/power+control; captured H808S fixture -> heart rate; CPV-carrying inventory -> cadence when the probe found crank data, absent otherwise); SourceMapper auto-assigns each free data type to the first capable device, rejects silent reassignment when a second capable device connects, applies manual override, and persists assignments across store round-trips; HeartRateMeasurement parses the captured H808S 0x2A37 frames byte-exactly (fixture bytes, not invented frames); CyclingPowerVector derives cadence from cumulative crank revolutions and last crank event time or is absent per the recorded probe outcome; the multi-device fake-backend contract tests show trainer + strap connected simultaneously with the trainer's 002 control path unchanged, per-device independent reconnect loops with backoff (strap drop leaves trainer riding), SessionController auto-connect order (trainer first, then sensors) at launch with remembered identities, and Disconnect-all performing the trainer min-load release then dropping every source; telemetry heartRateBpm/cadenceRpm ride the same 3 s stale clock; no speed source exists and no speed is rendered.

judgments.title: Hardware capture provenance for the H808S strap and the H1 0x2A65 cadence probe

criteria: R1 Strap capture: the evidence shows the powered-on COOSPO H808S was captured on the target Linux machine; the committed fixture (core/src/commonTest/resources/fixtures/hr-h808s-gatt-inventory.json) carries capture provenance (date, method, machine) and its service/characteristic list reflects real hardware, not a hand-invented Heart Rate Service template.

R2 Live frames: captured live 0x2A37 Heart Rate Measurement frames are committed (fixture or notes) and the parser tests use those exact bytes; if the strap deviates from the standard flags+bpm layout, the deviation is documented and the parser matches the captured reality.

R3 Cadence probe: the notes record the H1 0x2A65 (Cycling Power Vector) probe outcome either way — cumulative crank revolutions present (cadence in-slice, derivation documented) or absent (cadence deferred honestly) — and the shipped behavior matches the recorded outcome.
R4 Concurrency evidence: the capture notes state whether trainer + strap held simultaneous BlueZ connections during capture, since req-simultaneous depends on it.
R5 Privacy: the committed fixture and evidence contain no Bluetooth addresses (probe privacy scan reports clean).

required_evidence: probe output: fixture present, parseable, service list printed
probe output: capture provenance date present, 0x2A65 outcome recorded
implementation notes with capture provenance under docs/features/003-multi-sensor-telemetry/implementation/

judgments.title: Live acceptance ride with trainer and worn HR strap

criteria: R1 Simultaneous live data: the ride evidence shows live watts and live bpm on the ride screen at the same time, with the trainer holding ERG at the target throughout.
R2 Launch auto-connect: with remembered trainer and strap, an app restart auto-connected both (trainer first, ERG engaging) and landed on the ride screen without manual selection.
R3 Capability badges: the devices screen shows the trainer and the strap with their discovered capability badges.

R4 Strap drop isolation: removing or powering off the strap mid-ride turned the HR readout red/em-dash within 3 seconds while watts and ERG control were unaffected; the status line named the HR reconnect attempts.
R5 Strap recovery: re-powering the strap recovered it independently; the trainer never left the riding state.
R6 Source mapping: the data-sources dropdown showed the strap as the heart-rate source, and any override performed during the ride is reflected and remembered.
R7 Disconnect-all: ride-screen Disconnect released the trainer to minimum load and also disconnected the strap; the release state was reported honestly.

R8 Evidence quality: the ride evidence (log excerpt and/or screen capture) is committed under docs/features/003-multi-sensor-telemetry/implementation/, covers at least a 5-minute ride, contains no Bluetooth addresses, and reflects the real Hammer + H808S (not fake clients).

required_evidence: probe output: implementation evidence files listed and non-empty
committed ride evidence: log excerpt or screen capture of the dual-device ride
rider confirmation of each checklist item in the evidence doc
